name: Wyapy Customer Feedback for WooCommerce
author: wyapy

sections.description:
Wyapy Customer Feedback for WooCommerce lets you collect structured customer feedback at two key moments:

  • On the WooCommerce “Thank you” page (post checkout survey).
  • A few days after order completion (post delivery survey reached from a feedback request sent by email).

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the Wyapy service, where you can manage surveys, questions and analytics.

Main features:

  • Embed a customer satisfaction survey directly on the order confirmation page.
  • Gather per-item or categorized customer feedback after delivery.
  • Schedule transactional feedback request emails a configurable number of days after order completion.
  • Advanced analytics and AI reports available inside the Wyapy dashboard loaded inside your admin console.

This plugin requires WooCommerce.

How it works

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Connect your store to Wyapy.
  3. Wyapy creates a workspace and default projects for your store.
  4. Configure:
    • Post checkout survey
    • Post delivery survey
  5. Wyapy embeds a survey iframe on the Thank you page and schedules post delivery emails using Action Scheduler.

All post delivery emails sent by this plugin are transactional and related to the specific order. They are not categorized as marketing emails.

Data sent to Wyapy

To provide feedback and analytics, the plugin sends limited order data to the Wyapy API, such as:

  • Order ID.
  • Order status and completion time.
  • Items and totals necessary to associate feedback with an order.
  • Store identifier and project configuration.

The plugin does not send your WooCommerce login credentials or customer personal data (for example name, email address, phone number, billing/shipping address).
Customer email addresses are not sent to Wyapy servers. Post-delivery feedback request emails are sent by your WooCommerce site to the order email address.

You can remove all plugin configuration and order meta created by the plugin via the WordPress Plugins → Delete flow.

For more information about data handling, please read the Wyapy privacy policy on https://wyapy.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder wyapy-customer-feedback-for-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it via the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is active.
  4. Follow the on screen instructions from the Wyapy plugin section:
    • Create or connect your Wyapy workspace.
    • Enable post checkout survey if you want feedback on the Thank you page.
    • Enable post delivery survey and set the delay in days.
    • Grant email sending consent to enable sending transactional feedback request emails from your WooCommerce site.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Wyapy account?

Yes. The plugin will create or connect a Wyapy workspace for your store during the setup in WooCommerce admin.

Is Wyapy free?

Wyapy offers a free plan that includes up to 20 feedback responses per month.

Paid subscription is 29USD/month (and currently at 70% off with promo code WOOCOMMERCE70).

Are the feedback emails marketing emails?

No. Post delivery emails triggered by this plugin are transactional messages related to a specific order and used only to request feedback on that order.

Does this plugin store data outside my site?

Yes. Feedback responses and analytics are stored in Wyapy so that you can see aggregated reports and manage your surveys. The plugin sends limited order related data needed to associate feedback with orders.

Can I disable emails and only use the checkout survey?

Yes. You can:

  • Enable or disable the post checkout survey.
  • Enable or disable the post delivery survey.
  • Adjust the delay in days for the post delivery survey.

All these settings are available on the Wyapy Home page inside your admin console.

Who sends the post-delivery feedback email?

The email is sent by your WooCommerce site.
